created_by.description: Filter to scanners created by the given user IDs (comma-separated).

emits_signals.description: Filter to scanners that emit Signals.

enabled.description: Filter by enabled state. Accepts a comma-separated list of `enabled`/`disabled`.

experiment_id.description: Filter to scanners whose targeting watches the given experiment.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

order_by.description: Sort scanners by name, created_at, updated_at, scanner_type, enabled, sampling_rate, created_by, credits_this_month. Prefix with `-` for descending.

scanner_type.description: Filter by scanner type (monitor, classifier, scorer, summarizer). Accepts a comma-separated list.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match across name, description, and the prompt in scanner_config.

tags.description: Filter to scanners carrying at least one of the given tags (comma-separated).
